overview_description.description: MochaTrade is a mobile‑first fintech platform that lets global retail investors trade leveraged perpetual futures on US stocks, indices, and commodities (like Apple, Tesla, the S&P 500, and gold) without needing a traditional US brokerage account. It focuses on emerging‑market users, offering 24/7 trading with real‑time settlement and up to roughly 20× leverage.
